blurb: First run on the corrected engine, after movement speed was found to be 20% slow for every unit. Anchored to the behaviour clone at 0.1. Best policy this project has produced against the rule engine; note it gives up ground against meta decks, because it was selected against the rule engine alone.
measured: held out, seed 9000, 200 games each: 92.0% vs rule engine (W184 L16, hog 19%), 75.0% vs meta decks (W150 L50, hog 18%)
